siteSettings.title: English Adventures: Time & Place in Reported Speech

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Time/Place Changes Mastery
modules.instructions: Master time expression changes (now→then, today→that day, yesterday→the day before) and place changes (here→there, this→that). Understand contextual reporting.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Contextual Reporting Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences applying correct time/place shifts based on reporting context. Practice when expressions change vs. stay the same.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Time/Place Transformation Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing correct time/place expressions in reported speech. Recognize contextual clues that trigger changes.

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Time/Place Vocabulary Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply time markers, place references, and contextual connectors correctly in reported contexts.
